releases.name: 1.0.103 · 密码库打开与 Bitwarden 登录修复 / Vault opening and Bitwarden login fixes
releases.body:
# Monica for Extension 1.0.103

2026-10-31 · 标签 / Tag: `v1.0.103` · Windows x64 可选助手 / Optional helper: `0.1.5`

## 中文

- 首次使用可直接打开独立 MDBX、完整 MDBX ZIP 备份和 KeePass KDBX。MDBX 在独立工作副本上升级，保留原文件；扩展保护与数据库解锁分别设置。注册期间取消、锁定或日志写入失败时保留已接入副本，解锁后核验归属再重试。
- 修复 Bitwarden 首次登录各次请求使用不同设备标识，以及新设备邮件验证与两步验证接续时丢失验证码的问题。登录、邮件验证与 SSO 共用持久化设备标识，保留已连接账号原有标识；两种验证按任意顺序出现均保留当前登录状态。拒绝验证码后保留所选验证方式并明确提示，更换密码、账号、服务器或关闭弹窗会清除旧验证码。
- Bitwarden 登录增加美国、欧洲和自托管服务器选择，保留自托管地址草稿，请求期间锁定邮箱和服务器输入。密码与 SSO 登录兼容新版嵌套密钥响应，按服务端原始盐值和 KDF 解密，无效参数或密钥校验失败仍拒绝连接。改进密码错误、新设备验证码错误及已知客户端兼容拒绝提示；不回显凭据或任意服务端正文。登录、发送邮件验证码及首次数据库导入前检查页面与后台构建是否一致。
- 登录项附带的动态验证码同时显示在“动态验证码”。没有显式网址且标题为有效主机名的登录项参与网站匹配，已有网址及禁止匹配规则仍优先。
- 合入社区贡献：修复 Vivaldi 工具栏弹窗尺寸，MDBX 批量移动按目标分组复用冲突扫描，新增通过 OneDrive 连接与增量同步 MDBX。上传后核对实际内容，锁库或取消登录会中止请求。
- 修复旧版遗留本地只读导入项目无法删除的问题，支持移入回收站、恢复及确认清空；原始内容保留到永久删除。远端未知类型继续由原密码源管理，新 Bitwarden 明文 JSON 导入仍转换为本地可编辑项目。
- 本地同步增加实际网络接口的定向广播发现，改善电脑连接手机热点后无法通过组播发现设备的情况，保留设备身份验证与加密传输。此改动包含在可选 Windows 本机助手 0.1.5 中。
- Windows Hello 不可用时提示检查 Windows 本机通行密钥保存设置，提供公开 HRESULT、WebAuthn 错误名及 API 版本。创建与验证请求改用 JSON 序列化，保留本机平台验证器和强制用户验证。
- 更新 Vite、Vitest、Undici 和字体构建 Brotli 依赖，修复已知依赖漏洞。

安装或升级：下载 `monica-extension-1.0.103.zip`，解压至固定目录，在 Chrome/Edge 扩展管理页开启开发者模式并加载该目录。升级时保留原目录和扩展 ID，覆盖文件后重新加载扩展，再刷新已打开的网页，无需卸载扩展或重新导入密码库。

普通 MDBX 新建、导入、读取、编辑和保存使用扩展内置 WASM，无需外部组件。Wi-Fi 同步及部分本机能力使用**可选** Windows x64 助手 `monica-mdbx2-host-windows-x64-0.1.5.zip`；使用这些能力的用户可更新助手，安装方法见包内 README。旧 Native Host 工作副本保留原后端，迁移需明确操作。每个 ZIP 均附带 SHA-256 校验文件。

支持 Chrome/Edge 128+。Firefox 独立未签名构建保留在 CI artifact，永久安装需 Mozilla 签名，见 [Firefox 说明](https://github.com/Monica-Pass/Monica-for-Extension/blob/v1.0.103/docs/FIREFOX.md)，本次公开附件不含未签名 XPI。Bitwarden 合成服务及实际 Edge 回归已通过，反馈账号的官方云端登录、原 Windows Hello 故障设备和真实 OneDrive 账号互通仍待确认。验证范围见[发布检查记录](https://github.com/Monica-Pass/Monica-for-Extension/blob/main/docs/verification/release-1.0.103.md)。

## English

- First run can open standalone MDBX files, complete MDBX ZIP backups and KeePass KDBX databases. MDBX upgrades use independent working copies and preserve source files; extension protection and database unlock remain separate. Cancellation, locks and journal failures during registration preserve attached copies until ownership can be checked and retried after unlock.
- Fixed changing device identifiers across initial Bitwarden requests and lost verification state when new-device email verification and two-step verification occur in either order. Login, email verification and SSO reuse a persistent installation identifier while preserving existing connected-account identifiers. Rejected codes retain the selected method and show an explicit error; changing the password, account or server, or closing the dialog clears previous codes.
- Added US, EU and self-hosted Bitwarden server choices, retaining custom-address drafts and disabling email/server inputs during requests. Password and SSO login accept newer nested unlock metadata, using the exact server salt and KDF while rejecting invalid parameters or failed key authentication. Improved invalid-password, new-device-code and known client-compatibility errors without echoing credentials or arbitrary server responses. Login, email-code sending and first-run database import check that the page and background build agree.
- Login-attached OTPs also appear under authenticators. A valid hostname title can match websites when no explicit URL exists; explicit URLs and never-match rules retain priority.
- Integrated community fixes for Vivaldi toolbar popup sizing and per-collection MDBX move conflict scans, plus OneDrive connection and incremental synchronization for MDBX. Uploads verify stored content, and locking or cancelling login aborts requests.
- Old local readonly imports can now be moved to trash, restored and explicitly purged, preserving their original payload until permanent deletion. Unknown remote records remain managed by their source; new plaintext Bitwarden JSON imports continue to become editable local items.
- Native LAN synchronization probes directed broadcasts from actual local interfaces, helping discover devices when connected to phone hotspots that filter multicast. Device authentication and encrypted transport remain required. This change is included in the optional Windows helper 0.1.5.
- Unavailable Windows Hello errors explain the Windows setting for saving passkeys on this device and include public HRESULT, WebAuthn error name and API version diagnostics. Creation and assertion client data use JSON serialization; the local platform authenticator and required user verification remain enforced.
- Updated Vite, Vitest, Undici and the Brotli font-build dependency to address known dependency vulnerabilities.

Install or upgrade: extract `monica-extension-1.0.103.zip` to a permanent directory and load it in Chrome/Edge developer mode. To upgrade, keep the existing directory and extension ID, replace its files, reload the extension and refresh open websites. Uninstalling or reimporting the vault is unnecessary.

Ordinary MDBX creation, import, reads, edits and saves use bundled WASM and need no external component. Wi-Fi sync and some native abilities use the **optional** Windows x64 helper `monica-mdbx2-host-windows-x64-0.1.5.zip`; users of these abilities can update it using the README inside the package. Existing Native Host working copies retain their backend until explicitly migrated. Each ZIP includes a SHA-256 sidecar.

Chrome/Edge 128+ are supported. The separate unsigned Firefox build remains a CI artifact; permanent installation requires Mozilla signing. See [Firefox instructions](https://github.com/Monica-Pass/Monica-for-Extension/blob/v1.0.103/docs/FIREFOX.md); this release does not attach an unsigned XPI. Synthetic Bitwarden service and actual Edge regressions pass, while the reporting official-cloud account, original Windows Hello device and real OneDrive-account interoperability still need confirmation. See [release verification](https://github.com/Monica-Pass/Monica-for-Extension/blob/main/docs/verification/release-1.0.103.md) for the tested scope.

releases.body:
# Monica for Extension 1.0.101

## 中文

Monica 浏览器插件的首个正式版，承接此前的 0.1.x 预览版。

- 加密本地密码库、网页账号与验证码填充、密码保存、Passkey，以及 MDBX、KeePass、WebDAV 和 Bitwarden 密码源。
- 对齐 Android 的新建分组，新增会员卡、积分卡和旅行票证；修复同步卡面图片随机加载失败，暂时隐藏支付方式新建入口。
- 长按或右键进入多选，支持批量收藏、传输和删除。操作栏固定悬浮在窗口底部，列表与分页按实际栏高留出空间，兼容侧栏、窄屏、大字体和矮窗口。
- 导出增加重新认证，可选剪贴板自动清理、加密恢复检查点、运行诊断与 GitHub 更新检测。
- 优化选中账号后的密码填充速度；Passkey 验证窗跟随配色，并可转交 Windows/浏览器验证器。
- 附近同步默认只发送新增和修改，历史删除由用户选择处理；修复 MDBX 恢复记录未实际落库的问题。

**安装与升级：** 下载 `monica-extension-1.0.101.zip`，解压到固定目录，在 Chrome/Edge 的扩展管理页开启开发者模式并加载该目录。升级时保留原加载路径与扩展 ID `lebnfedmijifofonogjdphpojihgohmc`，替换文件后重新加载，避免卸载导致本地数据被清除。

**Windows 辅助组件：** 附近同步通信组件已包含在插件 ZIP 内，可从设置下载并安装；旧版组件需要同步更新。本页另外提供可选的 `monica-mdbx2-host-windows-x64-0.1.4.zip`，用于本机 MDBX / Windows Hello。两者复用同一程序，无需都安装。CLI 联动默认关闭并标注“不完善”，其辅助程序由 CLI 项目提供。Firefox 源码构建仍需 Mozilla 签名才能永久安装，本次未发布未签名 XPI，亦未提交浏览器商店。

本轮通过 4,305 项单元测试、113 项原生测试和 58 项 Edge 验收；插件与辅助组件 ZIP 均通过两次独立打包一致性校验。下载附件均附 SHA-256 校验文件。

[完整发行说明](https://github.com/Monica-Pass/Monica-for-Extension/blob/v1.0.101/docs/releases/Monica-Extension-1.0.101.md) · [验证记录与适用范围](https://github.com/Monica-Pass/Monica-for-Extension/blob/v1.0.101/docs/verification/release-1.0.101.md)

## English

The first stable Monica browser-extension release, following the 0.1.x previews.

- Encrypted local vault, webpage login/OTP filling, password saving, Passkeys, and MDBX, KeePass, WebDAV and Bitwarden sources.
- Android-aligned creation groups, membership/rewards/travel cards, reliable synced card artwork, and hidden payment-account creation.
- Hold or right-click to select multiple items for favorites, transfer or trash. Actions float at the viewport bottom, with measured clearance after lists and pagination, including narrow sidebars, large text and short windows.
- Fresh export authentication, optional clipboard expiry, encrypted recovery checkpoints, diagnostics and GitHub update checks.
- Faster account-menu filling and themed Passkey verification, with Windows/browser authenticator handoff.
- Nearby sync sends additions and edits by default, asks how to handle historical deletions, and correctly applies restored MDBX records.

**Install or upgrade:** Extract `monica-extension-1.0.101.zip` to a permanent directory and load it in Chrome/Edge Developer mode. Retain the original directory and extension ID `lebnfedmijifofonogjdphpojihgohmc` when upgrading; replace the files and reload. Removing the extension can clear its local data.

**Windows helpers:** The Wi-Fi communication component is bundled in the extension ZIP and available from settings; update existing installations too. The optional `monica-mdbx2-host-windows-x64-0.1.4.zip` provides native MDBX / Windows Hello support using the same executable; installing both is unnecessary. CLI integration remains off by default and marked incomplete, with its helper distributed by the CLI project. Firefox builds still need Mozilla signing for permanent installation; unsigned XPI distribution and browser-store publication are outside this release.

Validation: 4,305 unit tests, 113 native tests and 58 Edge acceptance tests passed. Both ZIP packages were reproduced independently twice with identical bytes. SHA-256 checksum files accompany each download.

# 0.1.48 preview-beta

> **发布渠道 / Distribution**：GitHub 正式 Release（未标记 Pre-release，标签 `v0.1.48`） / regular GitHub Release, not marked Pre-release, tag `v0.1.48`。
> **构建性质 / Build quality**：preview-beta 试用版，不是稳定版，也不代表浏览器商店已上架 / preview-beta for testing and feedback, not a stable release or store listing。
> **支持范围 / Support**：Chrome 128 及以上为声明目标；Firefox 不支持 / Chrome 128+ is the declared target; Firefox is unsupported。
> **同步方向 / Sync direction**：Android 端“附近设备同步”务必选择“双向同步”；“仅发送”或“仅接收”可能与电脑端方向不兼容，导致同步无法开始。/ On Android, always select **Bidirectional** in Nearby sync; send-only or receive-only may be incompatible with the desktop direction and prevent a sync from starting.

## 中文

### 本版修复

- 修复通过 Wi-Fi 同步到扩展的大量 TOTP 认证器显示“不可用”：解码时按 Monica Android `TotpDataResolver` 的读入规则修复旧记录，包括 `secret` 字段里存了整段 `otpauth://`/`steam://` URI、period 或 digits 越界、缺少 `otpType` 的 Steam 认证器，以及 `key`/`serviceName`/`account` 旧字段别名。
- 修复 Android 写出的认证器被解码成 4 位验证码的问题。Kotlin 序列化会省略等于默认值的字段，扩展原先把缺失的 `digits`/`period` 读成 0；现在按 Android 的默认值 6 位、30 秒解码。
- 修复 0.1.47 已导入的本地条目：解码修复无法追溯已写入密码库的 4 位参数，现在解锁时会用附近设备同步保留的原始 Android 记录重新核对，只修复 `item_data` 中确实没有 `digits` 字段的条目；Android 明确保存的位数（包括确实设为 4 位的钥匙）保持原样。回收站中的条目同样会修复，恢复后即可正常显示。
- 生成端不再把 Android 仍能正常显示的钥匙判为不可用：非正 period 回退 30 秒、digits 收敛到 4–10、不可用计数器按 0 处理、Base32 字母表外的字符按 Android 生成器的方式跳过。
- 登录条目里内嵌的 TOTP 现在按 Android 的上下文规则读取：网址（或标题）作为 issuer、用户名（或标题）作为账户名；Steam 登录自动切换到 5 位 Steam Guard 规则。
- 带 issuer 的 Yandex 钥匙只有在 PIN 可用时才切换到 YAOTP；没有 PIN 时保持数字验证码，不再变成不可用。
- 条目编辑页的 TOTP 密钥新增显示/隐藏切换，与详情页一致，便于定位异常记录。
- 以上修复只影响读取与显示；未改动的记录在同步写回时保持原始字节不变，不会因此覆盖 Android 端数据。

### 升级与安装

- 扩展 ID 仍为 `lebnfedmijifofonogjdphpojihgohmc`。替换文件并在扩展管理页重新加载即可；不需要重新导出／恢复密码库，也不需要重新运行 `install-wifi.ps1` 或 `install-host.ps1`。
- Chrome：`chrome://extensions` → Monica → **重新加载**。
- Edge：`edge://extensions` → Monica → **重新加载**。
- 本版取代 0.1.47 的发布 ZIP；0.1.47 的安装包包含上述 TOTP 解析缺陷。

### 验证范围

- 构建、全量单元测试、TOTP 回归测试、安全审计与可复现打包结果见[发布验证记录](https://github.com/Monica-Pass/Monica-for-Extension/blob/v0.1.48/docs/verification/release-0.1.48.md)。
- 修复覆盖 Wi-Fi 同步、KeePass KDBX 安全条目与登录内嵌三条读取路径，均由单元测试锁定；验证使用仓库内的合成 fixture，未读取或回放真实密码库数据。
- Chrome 128+ 仍是声明目标；真实手机首次同步、Android 自动调度与 OneDrive 真实登录仍未验收。
- 本版未运行完整 `release:check`（含联网 npm 审计、Rust 测试和 Playwright E2E），验证范围以记录为准。

### 下载

- `monica-extension-0.1.48.zip`
- `monica-extension-0.1.48.zip.sha256`
- ZIP SHA-256：`a7a6d1080bb465675ac7abb8f25a3945c209227ae5a0df5d8f64246cdd7a5077`
- ZIP 大小：`13,758,195` 字节

下载 ZIP 并解压，在 `edge://extensions` 或 `chrome://extensions` 开启开发者模式，选择“加载已解压的扩展程序”并指向解压目录。下载列表只含插件 ZIP 与校验文件；依赖清单、许可证清单和源码提交证据已包含在 ZIP 内。

### 反馈

请注明版本、浏览器、密码来源与复现步骤。不要上传真实密码、Passkey 私钥或密码库。安全问题请按 [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/Monica-Pass/Monica-for-Extension/blob/main/SECURITY.md) 私下报告。

## English

### Fixes

- Fixed the many TOTP authenticators synced over Wi-Fi that showed “unavailable”: decoding now repairs legacy records with Monica Android's `TotpDataResolver` read rules, including a whole `otpauth://`/`steam://` URI stored in `secret`, out-of-range period or digits, Steam authenticators without `otpType`, and the legacy `key`/`serviceName`/`account` aliases.
- Fixed Android-written authenticators decoding to a 4-digit code. Kotlin serialisation omits fields equal to their defaults, and the extension previously read the missing `digits`/`period` as 0; they now decode to Android's defaults of 6 digits and 30 seconds.
- Fixed local items already imported by 0.1.47: a decoder fix cannot retroactively correct digit counts persisted in the vault, so unlocking now re-checks the original Android record retained by Nearby Sync. Only items whose `item_data` has no `digits` field are repaired; a digit count Android explicitly stored (including a genuine 4-digit key) is left untouched. Trashed items are repaired too, so restoring one shows the correct code.
- Generation no longer rejects keys Android still renders: a non-positive period falls back to 30 s, digits are clamped into 4–10, an unusable counter is read as 0, and characters outside the Base32 alphabet are skipped the way Android's generator does.
- An inline TOTP on a login now follows Android's context rules: the website (or title) becomes the issuer and the username (or title) the account name; Steam logins switch to the 5-character Steam Guard rule.
- An issuer-based Yandex key only switches to YAOTP when a usable PIN is present; without one it keeps rendering the numeric code instead of becoming unavailable.
- The item editor gains a show/hide toggle for the TOTP secret, matching the detail page, so a failing record can be diagnosed in place.
- These fixes only change reading and display; unchanged records keep their original bytes on sync write-back, so Android data is not overwritten by the repair.

### Upgrade and install

- The extension ID remains `lebnfedmijifofonogjdphpojihgohmc`. Replace the files and reload the extension; no vault export/restore and no `install-wifi.ps1`/`install-host.ps1` rerun are required.
- Chrome: open `chrome://extensions` and click **Reload** for Monica.
- Edge: open `edge://extensions` and click **Reload** for Monica.
- This release supersedes the 0.1.47 ZIP, which contains the TOTP parsing defects above.

### Verification

- The [release verification record](https://github.com/Monica-Pass/Monica-for-Extension/blob/v0.1.48/docs/verification/release-0.1.48.md) covers the build, full unit suite, TOTP regression tests, security audit and reproducible packaging results.
- The fixes cover all three read paths — Wi-Fi sync, KeePass KDBX secure items and inline login keys — and are locked by unit tests. Verification used synthetic fixtures from the repository; no real vault data was read or replayed.
- Chrome 128+ remains the declared target. Real-phone first sync, Android automatic scheduling and real OneDrive sign-in remain unverified.
- This build does not run the complete `release:check` (online npm audit, Rust tests, Playwright E2E); the verification record defines the accepted scope.

### Downloads

- `monica-extension-0.1.48.zip`
- `monica-extension-0.1.48.zip.sha256`
- ZIP SHA-256: `a7a6d1080bb465675ac7abb8f25a3945c209227ae5a0df5d8f64246cdd7a5077`
- ZIP size: `13,758,195` bytes

Extract the ZIP, enable Developer mode at `edge://extensions` or `chrome://extensions`, and choose “Load unpacked” pointing at the extracted directory. The download list contains only the extension ZIP and its checksum; dependency and license inventories and source-commit evidence are embedded in the ZIP.

### Feedback

Include the version, browser, password source and reproduction steps. Do not upload real passwords, Passkey private keys or vaults. Report security issues privately per [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/Monica-Pass/Monica-for-Extension/blob/main/SECURITY.md).

releases.body:
# Monica CLI 1.0.101

首个提供 Linux 和 Windows 安装包的正式版本。

## 功能

- MDBX3 本地保险库、数据库切换、嵌套分类和终端管理；支持与 Monica Android 使用相同的 API Key 和密钥条目格式。
- GitHub / GitLab MCP 凭据网关：按连接、仓库和操作授权，支持到期、调用额度、撤销及人工审批。
- OpenAI / Anthropic 本地模型中转，支持 JSON 与 SSE。客户端使用可撤销本地 Key，真实 Key 留在保险库内；可显式批准受 Tiga 绝对期限约束的模型会话。
- Codex / Claude Code 直连配置：手动输入 Key 或在主密码和 Tiga 导出授权后读取已绑定 Key；保留已有配置并在修改前备份。
- SSH / OpenPGP 密钥管理、WebDAV 保险库同步、结构化 JSON 输出、真实命令语法发现及中英文帮助。

## 下载与安装

- `monica-cli-1.0.101-windows-x86_64.zip`：Windows 10/11 x64，包含可直接运行的程序；静态链接 MSVC CRT，不要求安装 Rust。
- `monica-cli-1.0.101-linux-x86_64.tar.gz`：Linux x86_64，glibc 2.35 或更新版本（如 Ubuntu 22.04+、Debian 12+）。Alpine/musl 不适用。
- `monica-cli-1.0.101-source.tar.gz`：对应 CLI、固定 MDBX 提交和锁定的第三方依赖源码。安装 Rust 1.97 与 C 工具链后可离线构建。
- `SHA256SUMS`：下载校验值。压缩包内包含 `INSTALL.md`、许可证、第三方声明和 `BUILD-INFO.json`。

解压到可写的独立目录，运行 `monica` / `monica.exe`；首次运行可创建或打开保险库。便携包的数据保存在旁边的 `data/`。更新时关闭 Monica，保留整个 `data/` 及保险库附属文件。完整说明见 [安装与升级](https://github.com/Monica-Pass/Monica-cli/blob/v1.0.101/docs/release-install.md)。

## 验证与边界

Linux 和 Windows 包均经过隔离构建、CLI 回归、Clippy、命令文档一致性检查，以及解包后启动验证。固定引擎提交为 `f81d3f1f08589670e534473ab8e0030b796dfdf4`。WSL homoos 中的 Codex 0.152.1 和 Claude Code 2.1.258 已使用生成的直连配置，完成第三方 `glm-5.3-200k` 请求。

- 此次提供 x86_64 两平台包；没有 ARM64 或 macOS 包。
- 模型中转支持列模型、Responses、Chat Completions、Messages、count_tokens；不做协议互转、模型映射、故障转移、WebSocket、后台 Responses 或图像/音频/文件专用接口。
- 直连文件包含原始 Key；Monica grant 的期限、撤销、次数和锁库不控制直连请求。需在上游轮换/撤销 Key，并妥善保管客户端文件与备份。
- Android 回写夹具测试因缺少独立 Android 产物仍为忽略；不宣称所有第三方模型或 Android 往返场景均已验证。
- Windows 包尚未进行代码签名；校验值用于核对下载完整性。此版本没有改动 Android、F-Droid 或 MDBX 数据库模型。

文档站：[安装与发布](https://monica-pass.github.io/MonicaDocs/reference/monica-cli-installation)。
